description: Drives whose top speed passed your threshold, checked against the real speed limit: a drive only counts as speeding when an incident above the road's limit backs it up.

panels.title: Drives over threshold
panels.description: Drives whose top speed was above the threshold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS drives FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold

panels.title: ...and over the limit
panels.description: Of those, drives where you were also above the road's speed limit at that speed. The rest were legally fast (for example 130 on a 130 road) or are not checked yet.

targets.rawSql: WITH worst AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.drive_id) i.drive_id, i.max_speed, i.speed_limit, i.max_over, i.road_name, i.road_numbers, i.start_lat, i.start_lon, i.hour_utc, i.weather_main, i.congestion_ratio FROM speeding_incidents i WHERE i.car_id = $car_id AND i.start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND i.start_ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY i.drive_id, i.max_over DESC), cnt AS (SELECT drive_id, count(*) AS n FROM speeding_incidents WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND start_ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS confirmed FROM drives d JOIN worst w ON w.drive_id = d.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold AND convert_km(w.max_speed::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold
SELECT convert_km(max(d.speed_max)::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "max_$length_unit" FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3

panels.title: Top speed over the limit
panels.description: Highest speed reached during an incident (above the limit).

targets.rawSql: WITH worst AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.drive_id) i.drive_id, i.max_speed, i.speed_limit, i.max_over, i.road_name, i.road_numbers, i.start_lat, i.start_lon, i.hour_utc, i.weather_main, i.congestion_ratio FROM speeding_incidents i WHERE i.car_id = $car_id AND i.start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND i.start_ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY i.drive_id, i.max_over DESC), cnt AS (SELECT drive_id, count(*) AS n FROM speeding_incidents WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND start_ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1) SELECT convert_km(max(w.max_speed)::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "max_over_limit_$length_unit" FROM drives d JOIN worst w ON w.drive_id = d.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS pct FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3

panels.title: Not checked yet
panels.description: High-speed drives not yet matched to the road network. The nightly job and the month-end backfill work through them.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS unchecked FROM drives d LEFT JOIN speeding_drive_status s ON s.drive_id = d.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold AND s.drive_id IS NULL

panels.title: High-speed drives by day
panels.description: All drives above the threshold, and how many of them were also over the limit. Drag across bars to zoom.

targets.rawSql: WITH worst AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.drive_id) i.drive_id, i.max_speed, i.speed_limit, i.max_over, i.road_name, i.road_numbers, i.start_lat, i.start_lon, i.hour_utc, i.weather_main, i.congestion_ratio FROM speeding_incidents i WHERE i.car_id = $car_id AND i.start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND i.start_ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY i.drive_id, i.max_over DESC), cnt AS (SELECT drive_id, count(*) AS n FROM speeding_incidents WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND start_ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1) SELECT date_trunc('day', d.start_date) AS time, count(*) AS "High-speed drives", count(*) FILTER (WHERE convert_km(w.max_speed::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold) AS "of which over the limit" FROM drives d LEFT JOIN worst w ON w.drive_id = d.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where the worst moment of each drive was
panels.description: One marker per high-speed drive at its worst over-the-limit moment (snapped to the road).

targets.rawSql: WITH worst AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.drive_id) i.drive_id, i.max_speed, i.speed_limit, i.max_over, i.road_name, i.road_numbers, i.start_lat, i.start_lon, i.hour_utc, i.weather_main, i.congestion_ratio FROM speeding_incidents i WHERE i.car_id = $car_id AND i.start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND i.start_ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY i.drive_id, i.max_over DESC), cnt AS (SELECT drive_id, count(*) AS n FROM speeding_incidents WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND start_ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1) SELECT d.id AS drive_id, d.start_date AS time, w.start_lat::float AS latitude, w.start_lon::float AS longitude, convert_km(w.max_over::numeric, '$length_unit') AS over, w.max_speed AS speed, w.speed_limit AS "limit", COALESCE(w.road_name, w.road_numbers) AS road FROM drives d JOIN worst w ON w.drive_id = d.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold ORDER BY w.max_over LIMIT 2000

layers.name: Where the worst moment of each drive was

panels.title: Worst incident of the chosen drive
panels.description: The exact snapped stretch where the chosen drive was furthest over the limit. Choose the drive in 'Drive on path map' above, or click a time in the table below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.ord::int AS idx, (c.coord->>1)::float AS latitude, (c.coord->>0)::float AS longitude, i.max_over AS over FROM speeding_incidents i, jsonb_array_elements(i.path->'coordinates') WITH ORDINALITY AS c(coord, ord) WHERE i.id = (SELECT id FROM speeding_incidents WHERE drive_id = NULLIF('$fast_drive', '')::int ORDER BY max_over DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY c.ord

layers.name: Worst incident of the chosen drive

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') / 10, 0) * 10 AS "Top speed of the drive", count(*) AS "Drives" FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND d.speed_max IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING round(convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') / 10, 0) * 10 > 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top high-speed drives
panels.description: Fastest drives first. Status tells you whether the speed was actually above the limit.

targets.rawSql: WITH worst AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.drive_id) i.drive_id, i.max_speed, i.speed_limit, i.max_over, i.road_name, i.road_numbers, i.start_lat, i.start_lon, i.hour_utc, i.weather_main, i.congestion_ratio FROM speeding_incidents i WHERE i.car_id = $car_id AND i.start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND i.start_ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY i.drive_id, i.max_over DESC), cnt AS (SELECT drive_id, count(*) AS n FROM speeding_incidents WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND start_ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1) SELECT d.id AS drive_id, d.start_date AS time, convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "top_speed_$length_unit", convert_km(d.distance::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "distance_$length_unit", CASE WHEN s.drive_id IS NULL THEN 'not checked yet' WHEN s.status <> 'done' THEN s.status WHEN w.drive_id IS NULL THEN 'within the limits' ELSE 'over the limit' END AS status, w.speed_limit AS "limit_at_worst", w.max_speed AS "speed_at_worst", convert_km(w.max_over::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "over_$length_unit", coalesce(c.n, 0) AS incidents, COALESCE(w.road_name, w.road_numbers) AS road, COALESCE(sg.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(sa.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', sa.road, sa.house_number), '')), sa.city)) AS start_address, COALESCE(eg.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(ea.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', ea.road, ea.house_number), '')), ea.city)) AS end_address FROM drives d LEFT JOIN speeding_drive_status s ON s.drive_id = d.id LEFT JOIN worst w ON w.drive_id = d.id LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.drive_id = d.id LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id LEFT JOIN geofences sg ON sg.id = d.start_geofence_id LEFT JOIN geofences eg ON eg.id = d.end_geofence_id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold ORDER BY d.speed_max DESC LIMIT 200

value.title: Show the worst incident on the map

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(eg.name, COALESCE(ea.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', ea.road, ea.house_number), '')), ea.city, 'Unknown') AS location, count(*) AS high_speed_drives FROM drives d LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id LEFT JOIN geofences eg ON eg.id = d.end_geofence_id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT extract(hour FROM d.start_date)::int AS "Hour of day (UTC)", count(*) AS "High-speed drives" FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Traffic on high-speed drives
panels.description: Congestion estimate of the drive's worst moment (counts).

targets.rawSql: WITH worst AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.drive_id) i.drive_id, i.max_speed, i.speed_limit, i.max_over, i.road_name, i.road_numbers, i.start_lat, i.start_lon, i.hour_utc, i.weather_main, i.congestion_ratio FROM speeding_incidents i WHERE i.car_id = $car_id AND i.start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND i.start_ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY i.drive_id, i.max_over DESC), cnt AS (SELECT drive_id, count(*) AS n FROM speeding_incidents WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND start_ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN w.congestion_ratio IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN w.congestion_ratio < 0.2 THEN '1 free-flowing' WHEN w.congestion_ratio < 0.5 THEN '2 some traffic' ELSE '3 slow / congested' END AS "Traffic", count(*) AS "High-speed drives" FROM drives d LEFT JOIN worst w ON w.drive_id = d.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH worst AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.drive_id) i.drive_id, i.max_speed, i.speed_limit, i.max_over, i.road_name, i.road_numbers, i.start_lat, i.start_lon, i.hour_utc, i.weather_main, i.congestion_ratio FROM speeding_incidents i WHERE i.car_id = $car_id AND i.start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND i.start_ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY i.drive_id, i.max_over DESC), cnt AS (SELECT drive_id, count(*) AS n FROM speeding_incidents WHERE car_id = $car_id AND start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day' AND start_ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(w.weather_main, 'unknown') AS "Weather", count(*) AS "High-speed drives" FROM drives d LEFT JOIN worst w ON w.drive_id = d.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

list.name: car_id
list.label: Car
list.definition:
SELECT
    id as __value,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(id) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(name, ' - ', RIGHT(vin, 6)) ELSE COALESCE(name, CONCAT('VIN ', vin)) end as __text 
FROM cars
ORDER BY display_priority ASC, name ASC, vin ASC;
list.query:
SELECT
    id as __value,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(id) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(name, ' - ', RIGHT(vin, 6)) ELSE COALESCE(name, CONCAT('VIN ', vin)) end as __text 
FROM cars
ORDER BY display_priority ASC, name ASC, vin ASC;

list.name: speed_unit
list.definition: SELECT CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'km' THEN 'km/h' WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 'mph' END
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'km' THEN 'km/h' WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 'mph' END

list.name: speed_threshold
list.label: Speed threshold
list.description: A drive counts as high-speed when its top speed is above this (km/h or mph, per your unit setting).

list.name: fast_drive
list.label: Drive on path map
list.definition: SELECT d.id AS __value, concat(to_char(d.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), '  top ', convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit'), ' ', '$speed_unit') AS __text FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM speeding_incidents s WHERE s.drive_id = d.id) ORDER BY d.speed_max DESC LIMIT 200
list.query: SELECT d.id AS __value, concat(to_char(d.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), '  top ', convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit'), ' ', '$speed_unit') AS __text FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.distance >= 0.3 AND convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') > $speed_threshold AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM speeding_incidents s WHERE s.drive_id = d.id) ORDER BY d.speed_max DESC LIMIT 200
